table.retrieve:
SELECT invcode     = dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,    
         date        = CASE lower(:as_datetype)  
									 When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate 
									 When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.date
									 When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.billingdate
							  END	,    
         flatdisc    = dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc, 
			salestax    = dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax,       
         misccharges = dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges, 
			invdiscperc = dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc, 
			invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledgermodified.invgstperc1,
			doctype = Case dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
         dbo.accounts.name, 
			dbo.customer.cp,
			dbo.customer.address1,
			dbo.customer.address2,
			dbo.customer.city,
			salereturn = (Select count(*) From SrLedger Where dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.srledger.saleinvcode ),
         amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty * dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice), 2),    
			itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty  * ( dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice - dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc * .01) + (dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty  * dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
    		invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice - dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc /100), 2),
			totaldiscount=Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty  * ( dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice - dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc * .01) + (dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty  * dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc)), 2)
								+
								Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice - dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc /100), 2)
								+ 
								dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc,
			itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty * dbo.saledetailmodified.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty * (dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice - dbo.saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.saledetailmodified.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ) ,
			regno = (Select dbo.patient.regno From dbo.Patient Where dbo.saleledgermodified.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode ),
			patientname = (Select dbo.patient.name From dbo.Patient Where dbo.saleledgermodified.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode ),
			designation = (Select dbo.rank.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Rank Where dbo.saleledgermodified.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode),
         department = (Select dbo.unit.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Unit Where dbo.saleledgermodified.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.unitcode = dbo.unit.unitcode)

    FROM dbo.saleledgermodified, 
         dbo.saledetailmodified,   
         dbo.accounts, 
			dbo.customer	

   WHERE dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode and  
			CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
									 When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate 
									 When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.date
									 When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.billingdate
			END Between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and
			dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
			dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode  = :al_CustCode and 
         dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and	
         dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode 

GROUP BY dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,   
			CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
				When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate 
				When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.date
				When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.billingdate
		   END,   
			dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc,  
			dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax, 
			dbo.saleledgermodified.invgstperc1,
			dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode, 
			dbo.saleledgermodified.patientcode,
			dbo.saleledgermodified.custrefno,	 
			dbo.saleledgermodified.remarks,
			dbo.accounts.name,	
			dbo.customer.cp,
			dbo.customer.address1,
			dbo.customer.address2,
			dbo.customer.city
         
ORDER BY dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode ASC,   
         CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
									 When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate 
									 When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.date
									 When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.billingdate
		  	END ASC

objects.name: c_cumsumheadertotalamount
objects.expression: cumsum( Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_salestaxvalue )  -  ( Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_salestaxvalue )

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum(  Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)   for all)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: cumsum( Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_salestaxvalue )

objects.name: netamount
objects.expression: Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_salestaxvalue
